USE MYSchoolDB
GO

-- 1. Overall average grade for one student (0–100)
IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.objects WHERE type='FN' AND name='calculate_Student_Overall_Grade')
    DROP FUNCTION calculate_Student_Overall_Grade;
GO
CREATE FUNCTION calculate_Student_Overall_Grade(@Student_Id INT)
RETURNS FLOAT
AS
BEGIN
    DECLARE @Student_Overall_Grade FLOAT;
    -- Average of every mark entered so far. AVG skips NULLs, so a mark that isn't in yet
    -- doesn't count as 0, and the FLOAT cast stops integer division cutting off decimals.
    SELECT @Student_Overall_Grade = AVG(CAST(m.Mark AS FLOAT))
    FROM Student_Grades
    CROSS APPLY (VALUES (First_Grade), (Second_Grade), (third_Grade), (Final_Grade)) AS m(Mark)
    WHERE Student_Id = @Student_Id;
    RETURN @Student_Overall_Grade;
END;
GO

-- 2. Students in a governorate
IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.objects WHERE type='FN' AND name='Student_Numbers_for_each_governate')
    DROP FUNCTION Student_Numbers_for_each_governate;
GO
CREATE FUNCTION Student_Numbers_for_each_governate(@GOV_ID INT)
RETURNS INT
AS
BEGIN
    DECLARE @n INT;
    SELECT @n = COUNT(DISTINCT Student_Addresses.Student_Id)
    FROM Student_Addresses
    INNER JOIN Address      ON Student_Addresses.Address_Id = Address.Address_Id
    INNER JOIN Governorates ON Governorates.Gov_Id = Address.Gov_Id
    WHERE Governorates.Gov_Id = @GOV_ID;
    RETURN @n;
END;
GO

-- 3. Teachers for a subject
IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.objects WHERE type='FN' AND name='Number_of_Teachers_For_each_Subject')
    DROP FUNCTION Number_of_Teachers_For_each_Subject;
GO
CREATE FUNCTION Number_of_Teachers_For_each_Subject(@Subject_Id NVARCHAR(10))
RETURNS INT
AS
BEGIN
    DECLARE @n INT;
    SELECT @n = COUNT(DISTINCT Teacher_Id)
    FROM Teacher_Class_Assignments
    INNER JOIN Subjects ON Subjects.Subject_Id = Teacher_Class_Assignments.Subject_Id
    WHERE Subjects.Subject_Id = @Subject_Id;
    RETURN @n;
END;
GO

-- 4. Full detail rows for one student (inline TVF)
IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.objects WHERE type='IF' AND name='Student_Details')
    DROP FUNCTION Student_Details;
GO
CREATE FUNCTION Student_Details(@Student_Id INT)
RETURNS TABLE
AS
RETURN (
    SELECT Student.Student_id, Student.First_Name AS SFN, Student.Last_Name AS SLN,
           Student.Class_Level, Student.class_Letter,
           Teacher.First_name, Teacher.Last_name,
           Subjects.Subject_Name_Ar, Subjects.Subject_Name_En,
           Student_Grades.First_Grade, Student_Grades.Second_Grade,
           Student_Grades.third_Grade, Student_Grades.Final_Grade,
          (SELECT CAST(AVG(CAST(m.Mark AS DECIMAL(5,2))) AS DECIMAL(5,2))
             FROM (VALUES (Student_Grades.First_Grade), (Student_Grades.Second_Grade),
                          (Student_Grades.third_Grade), (Student_Grades.Final_Grade)) AS m(Mark))
              AS Student_Avg_Grade   -- marks entered so far, with decimals
    FROM Student_Grades
    INNER JOIN Student ON Student.Student_Id = Student_Grades.Student_Id
    INNER JOIN Teacher_Class_Assignments
        ON Teacher_Class_Assignments.Class_Level  = Student.Class_Level
       AND Teacher_Class_Assignments.class_Letter = Student.class_Letter
       AND Teacher_Class_Assignments.Subject_Id   = Student_Grades.Subject_Id
       AND Teacher_Class_Assignments.Course_Level = Student_Grades.Course_Level   -- added
    INNER JOIN Teacher  ON Teacher.Teacher_Id  = Teacher_Class_Assignments.Teacher_Id
    INNER JOIN Subjects ON Subjects.Subject_Id = Student_Grades.Subject_Id
    WHERE Student.Student_id = @Student_Id
);
GO

-- 5. Top-three students in a class (inline TVF)
IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.objects WHERE type='IF' AND name='First_three_student_in_each_class')
    DROP FUNCTION First_three_student_in_each_class;
GO
CREATE FUNCTION First_three_student_in_each_class(@Class_Level TINYINT, @class_letter CHAR(1))
RETURNS TABLE
AS
RETURN (
    SELECT * FROM (
        SELECT Student.Student_id, Student.First_Name, Student.Last_Name,
               Student.Class_level, Student.class_Letter,
               dbo.calculate_Student_Overall_Grade(Student.Student_id) AS student_Overall_mark,
               DENSE_RANK() OVER (
                   PARTITION BY Student.Class_Level, Student.class_Letter
                   ORDER BY dbo.calculate_Student_Overall_Grade(Student.Student_id) DESC
               ) AS Student_rank
        FROM Student
        INNER JOIN class
            ON Student.Class_level  = class.Class_Level
           AND Student.class_Letter = class.class_Letter
        WHERE class.Class_Level = @Class_Level AND class.class_Letter = @class_letter
    ) AS Ranked
    WHERE Student_rank <= 3        -- top three (was unfiltered)
);
GO

IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.databases WHERE name = 'MYSchoolDB')
BEGIN
    CREATE DATABASE MYSchoolDB;
END
GO

USE MYSchoolDB
GO

-----------------------------------------
-- independent Tables (no foreign keys)
-----------------------------------------

-- 1. Subjects
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.tables WHERE name = 'Subjects')
BEGIN
    CREATE TABLE Subjects (
        Subject_Id NVARCHAR(10) PRIMARY KEY,          -- Manual code: 'MATH', 'SCI', ...
        Subject_Name_Ar NVARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
        Subject_Name_En VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
        Required_Level TINYINT NOT NULL,              -- minimum level for the subject
        CONSTRAINT CHK_Minimum_Level CHECK (Required_Level >= 1 AND Required_Level <= 12)   -- [1]
    );
END
GO

-- 2. Teacher
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.tables WHERE name = 'Teacher')
BEGIN
    CREATE TABLE Teacher (
        Teacher_Id INT PRIMARY KEY,
        First_name NVARCHAR(30) NOT NULL,
        Last_name NVARCHAR(30) NOT NULL,
        Email VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
        Phone_Number VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
        hire_date DATE NOT NULL DEFAULT GETDATE(),
        specialization NVARCHAR(100),
        is_full_time BIT DEFAULT 1,
        qualification NVARCHAR(50) NOT NULL
    );
END
GO

-- 3. class
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.tables WHERE name = 'class')
BEGIN
    CREATE TABLE class (
        class_Letter CHAR(1) NOT NULL,
        Student_Capacity TINYINT NOT NULL,
        Class_Level TINYINT NOT NULL,
        Room_Number VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
        CONSTRAINT CHK_Class_Level CHECK (Class_Level >= 1 AND Class_Level <= 12),
        CONSTRAINT PK_Class PRIMARY KEY (Class_Level, class_Letter)
    );
END
GO

-- 4. Parents
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.tables WHERE name = 'Parents')
BEGIN
    CREATE TABLE Parents (
        Parental_Id INT PRIMARY KEY,
        First_name NVARCHAR(30) NOT NULL,
        Last_name NVARCHAR(30) NOT NULL,
        Email VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
        Phone_Number VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
        relationship NVARCHAR(30) NOT NULL,
        Occupation NVARCHAR(50) NOT NULL
    );
END
GO

-- 5. Governorates
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.tables WHERE name = 'Governorates')
BEGIN
    CREATE TABLE Governorates (
        Gov_Id TINYINT PRIMARY KEY,                   -- Manual IDs 1..12
        Gov_Name_Ar NVARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
        Gov_Name_En VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL
    );
END
GO

    (11, N'جرش', 'Jerash'),   (12, N'عجلون', 'Ajloun');
END
GO

------------------------------------------
-- dependent Tables (have foreign keys)
------------------------------------------

-- 6. Address
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.tables WHERE name = 'Address')
BEGIN
    CREATE TABLE Address (
        Address_Id INT PRIMARY KEY IDENTITY(1,1),
        Gov_Id TINYINT NOT NULL,
        District NVARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
        Street NVARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
        Building_No NVARCHAR(10) NOT NULL,
        CONSTRAINT FK_Address_Gov FOREIGN KEY (Gov_Id) REFERENCES Governorates(Gov_Id),
        CONSTRAINT UQ_Location UNIQUE (Gov_Id, District, Street, Building_No)
    );
END
GO

-- 7. Courses
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.tables WHERE name = 'Courses')
BEGIN
    CREATE TABLE Courses (
        Subject_Id NVARCHAR(10) NOT NULL,
        Learning_Materials NVARCHAR(MAX) NOT NULL,
        [Description] NVARCHAR(MAX) NOT NULL,
        Course_Level TINYINT NOT NULL,
        CONSTRAINT CHK_Course_Level CHECK (Course_Level >= 1 AND Course_Level <= 12),
        CONSTRAINT PK_Courses PRIMARY KEY (Subject_Id, Course_Level),
        CONSTRAINT FK_Course_Subject FOREIGN KEY (Subject_Id)
            REFERENCES Subjects(Subject_Id) ON UPDATE CASCADE
    );
END
GO

-- 8. Student
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.tables WHERE name = 'Student')
BEGIN
    CREATE TABLE Student (
        Student_Id INT PRIMARY KEY,
        First_Name NVARCHAR(30) NOT NULL,
        Last_Name NVARCHAR(30) NOT NULL,
        Date_of_Birth DATE NOT NULL,
        Gender CHAR(1) CHECK (Gender IN ('M', 'F')),
        Blood_Type VARCHAR(5),
        Medical_Conditions NVARCHAR(MAX),
        Class_Level TINYINT NOT NULL,
        class_Letter CHAR(1) NOT NULL,
        Parental_Id INT NOT NULL,
        CONSTRAINT FK_Student_Class FOREIGN KEY (Class_Level, class_Letter)
            REFERENCES class(Class_Level, class_Letter) ON UPDATE CASCADE,
        CONSTRAINT FK_Student_Parents FOREIGN KEY (Parental_Id)
            REFERENCES Parents(Parental_Id) ON UPDATE CASCADE
    );
END
GO

-- 9. Student_Addresses (junction)
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.tables WHERE name = 'Student_Addresses')
BEGIN
    CREATE TABLE Student_Addresses (
        Student_Id INT NOT NULL,
        Address_Id INT NOT NULL,
        Main_Address BIT DEFAULT 0,
        CONSTRAINT PK_Student_Addresses PRIMARY KEY (Student_Id, Address_Id),
        CONSTRAINT FK_SA_Student FOREIGN KEY (Student_Id)
            REFERENCES Student(Student_Id) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE CASCADE,
        CONSTRAINT FK_SA_Address FOREIGN KEY (Address_Id)
            REFERENCES Address(Address_Id) ON UPDATE CASCADE
    );
END
GO

-- 10. Teacher_Class_Assignments
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.tables WHERE name = 'Teacher_Class_Assignments')
BEGIN
    CREATE TABLE Teacher_Class_Assignments (
        Academic_Year SMALLINT NOT NULL,
        Semester TINYINT NOT NULL,
        Teacher_Id INT NOT NULL,
        Class_Level TINYINT NOT NULL,
        class_Letter CHAR(1) NOT NULL,
        Subject_Id NVARCHAR(10) NOT NULL,
        Course_Level TINYINT NOT NULL,
        CONSTRAINT PK_Assignments PRIMARY KEY (
            Academic_Year, Semester, Teacher_Id,
            Class_Level, class_Letter, Subject_Id, Course_Level),
        CONSTRAINT FK_Fact_Teacher FOREIGN KEY (Teacher_Id)
            REFERENCES Teacher(Teacher_Id) ON UPDATE CASCADE,
        CONSTRAINT FK_Fact_Class FOREIGN KEY (Class_Level, class_Letter)
            REFERENCES class(Class_Level, class_Letter) ON UPDATE CASCADE,
        CONSTRAINT FK_Fact_Course FOREIGN KEY (Subject_Id, Course_Level)
            REFERENCES Courses(Subject_Id, Course_Level) ON UPDATE CASCADE
    );
END
GO

-- 11. Student_Grades   [2] now its own block
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.tables WHERE name = 'Student_Grades')
BEGIN
    CREATE TABLE Student_Grades (
        Academic_Year SMALLINT NOT NULL,
        Semester TINYINT NOT NULL,
        Student_Id INT NOT NULL,
        Subject_Id NVARCHAR(10) NOT NULL,
        Course_Level TINYINT NOT NULL,
        First_Grade  INT CHECK (First_Grade  >= 0 AND First_Grade  <= 100),
        Second_Grade INT CHECK (Second_Grade >= 0 AND Second_Grade <= 100),
        third_Grade  INT CHECK (third_Grade  >= 0 AND third_Grade  <= 100),
        Final_Grade  INT CHECK (Final_Grade  >= 0 AND Final_Grade  <= 100),
        CONSTRAINT PK_Student_Grades PRIMARY KEY (
            Academic_Year, Semester, Student_Id, Subject_Id, Course_Level),
        CONSTRAINT FK_Student_Grades FOREIGN KEY (Student_Id)
            REFERENCES Student(Student_Id) ON UPDATE CASCADE,
        CONSTRAINT FK_Course_Grades FOREIGN KEY (Subject_Id, Course_Level)
            REFERENCES Courses(Subject_Id, Course_Level) ON UPDATE CASCADE
    );
END
GO

-- Dataset procs for the paginated reports in Reports\. Same rule as the other rpt_ procs:
-- one result set, input params only, no OUTPUT, no logging - just shaped data for SSRS.
USE MYSchoolDB;
GO

-- Subjects the student takes (through their class's teacher assignments) + who teaches each.
IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.objects WHERE type='P' AND name='rpt_StudentSchedule')
    DROP PROCEDURE rpt_StudentSchedule;
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE rpt_StudentSchedule
    @Student_Id    INT,
    @Academic_Year SMALLINT = NULL,
    @Semester      TINYINT  = NULL
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SELECT
        a.Academic_Year,
        a.Semester,
        a.Subject_Id,
        sub.Subject_Name_Ar,
        sub.Subject_Name_En,
        a.Course_Level,
        t.Teacher_Id,
        t.First_name + N' ' + t.Last_name AS Teacher_Name,
        CAST(a.Class_Level AS NVARCHAR(3)) + N'-' + a.class_Letter AS Class_Name
    FROM Student s
    JOIN Teacher_Class_Assignments a
         ON a.Class_Level = s.Class_Level AND a.class_Letter = s.class_Letter
    JOIN Subjects sub ON sub.Subject_Id = a.Subject_Id
    JOIN Teacher  t   ON t.Teacher_Id  = a.Teacher_Id
    WHERE s.Student_Id = @Student_Id
      AND (@Academic_Year IS NULL OR a.Academic_Year = @Academic_Year)
      AND (@Semester      IS NULL OR a.Semester      = @Semester)
    ORDER BY a.Academic_Year, a.Semester, sub.Subject_Name_En;
END
GO

-- One-row student profile: personal info + parent + class + GPA + class rank.
IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.objects WHERE type='P' AND name='rpt_StudentDetails')
    DROP PROCEDURE rpt_StudentDetails;
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE rpt_StudentDetails
    @Student_Id INT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SELECT
        s.Student_Id,
        s.First_Name,
        s.Last_Name,
        s.Date_of_Birth,
        DATEDIFF(YEAR, s.Date_of_Birth, GETDATE())
            - CASE WHEN MONTH(s.Date_of_Birth)*100 + DAY(s.Date_of_Birth)
                        > MONTH(GETDATE())*100 + DAY(GETDATE()) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS Age,
        s.Gender,
        s.Blood_Type,
        s.Medical_Conditions,
        CAST(s.Class_Level AS NVARCHAR(3)) + N'-' + s.class_Letter AS Class_Name,
        p.Parental_Id,
        p.First_name + N' ' + p.Last_name AS Parent_Name,
        p.relationship,
        p.Phone_Number AS Parent_Phone,
        p.Email        AS Parent_Email,
        p.Occupation,
        CAST(dbo.calculate_Student_Overall_Grade(s.Student_Id) AS DECIMAL(6,2)) AS GPA,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) + 1
           FROM Student s2
          WHERE s2.Class_Level  = s.Class_Level
            AND s2.class_Letter = s.class_Letter
            AND dbo.calculate_Student_Overall_Grade(s2.Student_Id)
                > dbo.calculate_Student_Overall_Grade(s.Student_Id)) AS Class_Rank
    FROM Student s
    JOIN Parents p ON p.Parental_Id = s.Parental_Id
    WHERE s.Student_Id = @Student_Id;
END
GO

-- All addresses on file for a student (main one first), resolved to governorate.
IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.objects WHERE type='P' AND name='rpt_StudentAddress')
    DROP PROCEDURE rpt_StudentAddress;
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE rpt_StudentAddress
    @Student_Id INT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SELECT
        s.Student_Id,
        s.First_Name + N' ' + s.Last_Name AS Student_Name,
        sa.Address_Id,
        sa.Main_Address,
        a.Building_No,
        a.Street,
        a.District,
        g.Gov_Id,
        g.Gov_Name_Ar,
        g.Gov_Name_En
    FROM Student s
    JOIN Student_Addresses sa ON sa.Student_Id = s.Student_Id
    JOIN Address a            ON a.Address_Id  = sa.Address_Id
    JOIN Governorates g       ON g.Gov_Id      = a.Gov_Id
    WHERE s.Student_Id = @Student_Id
    ORDER BY sa.Main_Address DESC, g.Gov_Name_En;
END
GO

-- All students grouped by class, with GPA - feeds the collapsible "Students by Class" report.
IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.objects WHERE type='P' AND name='rpt_StudentsByClass')
    DROP PROCEDURE rpt_StudentsByClass;
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE rpt_StudentsByClass
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SELECT
        CAST(s.Class_Level AS NVARCHAR(3)) + N'-' + s.class_Letter AS Class_Name,
        s.Class_Level,
        s.class_Letter,
        s.Student_Id,
        s.First_Name + N' ' + s.Last_Name AS Student_Name,
        s.Gender,
        CAST(dbo.calculate_Student_Overall_Grade(s.Student_Id) AS DECIMAL(6,2)) AS GPA
    FROM Student s
    ORDER BY s.Class_Level, s.class_Letter, s.Last_Name, s.First_Name;
END
GO

-- The four procs below are used by the .rdl files but were only in the live database,
-- so a fresh install from these scripts couldn't run the reports.

-- Student picker for the report parameters: "2026101 - Name (1-A)".
IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.objects WHERE type='P' AND name='rpt_StudentList')
    DROP PROCEDURE rpt_StudentList;
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE rpt_StudentList
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SELECT
        s.Student_Id,
        CAST(s.Student_Id AS NVARCHAR(20)) + N' - ' + s.First_Name + N' ' + s.Last_Name
            + N' (' + CAST(s.Class_Level AS NVARCHAR(3)) + N'-' + s.class_Letter + N')' AS Display_Name
    FROM Student s
    ORDER BY s.Class_Level, s.class_Letter, s.Last_Name, s.First_Name;
END
GO

-- Teacher picker for the report parameters.
IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.objects WHERE type='P' AND name='rpt_TeacherList')
    DROP PROCEDURE rpt_TeacherList;
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE rpt_TeacherList
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SELECT
        t.Teacher_Id,
        CAST(t.Teacher_Id AS NVARCHAR(20)) + N' - ' + t.First_name + N' ' + t.Last_name AS Display_Name
    FROM Teacher t
    ORDER BY t.Last_name, t.First_name;
END
GO

-- Classes and subjects one teacher covers.
IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.objects WHERE type='P' AND name='rpt_TeacherSchedule')
    DROP PROCEDURE rpt_TeacherSchedule;
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE rpt_TeacherSchedule
    @Teacher_Id    INT,
    @Academic_Year SMALLINT = NULL,
    @Semester      TINYINT  = NULL
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SELECT
        a.Academic_Year,
        a.Semester,
        a.Class_Level,
        a.class_Letter,
        a.Subject_Id,
        sub.Subject_Name_En,
        a.Course_Level
    FROM Teacher_Class_Assignments a
    JOIN Subjects sub ON sub.Subject_Id = a.Subject_Id
    WHERE a.Teacher_Id = @Teacher_Id
      AND (@Academic_Year IS NULL OR a.Academic_Year = @Academic_Year)
      AND (@Semester      IS NULL OR a.Semester      = @Semester)
    ORDER BY a.Academic_Year, a.Semester, a.Class_Level, a.class_Letter, sub.Subject_Name_En;
END
GO

-- One line per subject for the Student Marks report.
IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.objects WHERE type='P' AND name='rpt_StudentReportCard_Lines')
    DROP PROCEDURE rpt_StudentReportCard_Lines;
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE rpt_StudentReportCard_Lines
    @Student_Id    INT,
    @Academic_Year SMALLINT = NULL,
    @Semester      TINYINT  = NULL
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SELECT
        g.Academic_Year,
        g.Semester,
        g.Subject_Id,
        sub.Subject_Name_Ar,
        sub.Subject_Name_En,
        g.Course_Level,
        g.First_Grade,
        g.Second_Grade,
        g.third_Grade,
        g.Final_Grade,
        (SELECT CAST(AVG(CAST(m.Mark AS DECIMAL(5,2))) AS DECIMAL(6,2))
           FROM (VALUES (g.First_Grade), (g.Second_Grade), (g.third_Grade), (g.Final_Grade)) AS m(Mark))
            AS Subject_Average   -- marks entered so far
    FROM Student_Grades g
    JOIN Subjects sub ON sub.Subject_Id = g.Subject_Id
    WHERE g.Student_Id = @Student_Id
      AND (@Academic_Year IS NULL OR g.Academic_Year = @Academic_Year)
      AND (@Semester      IS NULL OR g.Semester      = @Semester)
    ORDER BY g.Academic_Year, g.Semester, sub.Subject_Name_En;
END
GO

﻿# Build_Reports.ps1
# Generates the paginated .rdl reports in this folder, then (optionally) uploads them to SSRS.
#   .\Build_Reports.ps1            # just (re)write the .rdl files
#   .\Build_Reports.ps1 -Deploy    # write + publish to the report server
param([switch]$Deploy)

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$here = Split-Path -Parent $MyInvocation.MyCommand.Path

$DSRef = '/MYSchoolDS'            # shared data source already in the portal
$PortalFolder = '/SchoolReports'  # where the reports land in the portal
$ReportServer = 'http://localhost/ReportServer'

# --- tiny helpers ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
function XmlEsc([string]$s){ $s -replace '&','&' -replace '<','<' -replace '>','>' }

# A <Field> list from column specs (plus any extra field names used only in expressions)
function FieldsXml($cols, $extra){
    $sb = "      <Fields>`n"
    foreach($c in $cols){
        $sb += "        <Field Name=`"$($c.F)`"><DataField>$($c.F)</DataField><rd:TypeName>$($c.T)</rd:TypeName></Field>`n"
    }
    foreach($e in $extra){
        $sb += "        <Field Name=`"$($e.F)`"><DataField>$($e.F)</DataField><rd:TypeName>$($e.T)</rd:TypeName></Field>`n"
    }
    $sb + "      </Fields>"
}

# A stored-proc dataset bound to the shared data source
function ProcDataSet($name, $proc, $paramsXml, $fieldsXml){
@"
    <DataSet Name="$name">
      <Query>
        <DataSourceName>SchoolDBDataSource</DataSourceName>
        <CommandType>StoredProcedure</CommandType>
        <CommandText>$proc</CommandText>
$paramsXml
      </Query>
$fieldsXml
    </DataSet>
"@
}

# One header textbox cell
function HeadCell($text){
@"
                    <TablixCell><CellContents>
                      <Textbox Name="h$([guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N').Substring(0,8))">
                        <CanGrow>true</CanGrow>
                        <Paragraphs><Paragraph><TextRuns><TextRun><Value>$(XmlEsc $text)</Value>
                          <Style><FontSize>10pt</FontSize><FontWeight>Bold</FontWeight><Color>White</Color></Style></TextRun></TextRuns></Paragraph></Paragraphs>
                        <Style><BackgroundColor>#2e5b8a</BackgroundColor><PaddingLeft>3pt</PaddingLeft><PaddingTop>2pt</PaddingTop><PaddingBottom>2pt</PaddingBottom>
                          <Border><Color>White</Color><Style>Solid</Style><Width>0.5pt</Width></Border></Style>
                      </Textbox>
                    </CellContents></TablixCell>
"@
}

# One detail textbox cell bound to a field
function DataCell($col, $tbName){
    $align = if($col.A){$col.A}else{'Left'}
@"
                    <TablixCell><CellContents>
                      <Textbox Name="$tbName">
                        <CanGrow>true</CanGrow>
                        <Paragraphs><Paragraph><TextRuns><TextRun><Value>=Fields!$($col.F).Value</Value>
                          <Style><FontSize>10pt</FontSize><Color>#222222</Color></Style></TextRun></TextRuns>
                          <Style><TextAlign>$align</TextAlign></Style></Paragraph></Paragraphs>
                        <Style><PaddingLeft>3pt</PaddingLeft><PaddingTop>2pt</PaddingTop><PaddingBottom>2pt</PaddingBottom>
                          <Border><Color>#cccccc</Color><Style>Solid</Style><Width>0.5pt</Width></Border></Style>
                      </Textbox>
                    </CellContents></TablixCell>
"@
}

# A simple header+detail table (Tablix) over a dataset
function TableTablix($name, $dataset, $cols, $top){
    $colsXml=''; foreach($c in $cols){ $colsXml += "                <TablixColumn><Width>$($c.W)</Width></TablixColumn>`n" }
    $headXml=''; foreach($c in $cols){ $headXml += (HeadCell $c.H) }
    $dataXml=''; $i=0
    foreach($c in $cols){ $i++; $dataXml += (DataCell $c ("d_"+$name+"_"+$i)) }
    $colMembers=''; foreach($c in $cols){ $colMembers += "                  <TablixMember />`n" }
    $width = 0.0; foreach($c in $cols){ $width += [double]($c.W -replace 'in','') }
@"
          <Tablix Name="$name">
            <TablixBody>
              <TablixColumns>
$colsXml              </TablixColumns>
              <TablixRows>
                <TablixRow><Height>0.28in</Height><TablixCells>
$headXml                </TablixCells></TablixRow>
                <TablixRow><Height>0.25in</Height><TablixCells>
$dataXml                </TablixCells></TablixRow>
              </TablixRows>
            </TablixBody>
            <TablixColumnHierarchy><TablixMembers>
$colMembers              </TablixMembers></TablixColumnHierarchy>
            <TablixRowHierarchy><TablixMembers>
                <TablixMember><KeepWithGroup>After</KeepWithGroup></TablixMember>
                <TablixMember><Group Name="g_$name" /><TablixMembers><TablixMember /></TablixMembers></TablixMember>
            </TablixMembers></TablixRowHierarchy>
            <DataSetName>$dataset</DataSetName>
            <Top>$top</Top><Left>0in</Left><Height>0.53in</Height><Width>${width}in</Width>
          </Tablix>
"@
}

# Wrap body items into a full report document
function ReportDoc($datasetsXml, $bodyItems, $bodyHeight, $paramsXml, $paramLayout){
@"
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<Report xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/sqlserver/reporting/2016/01/reportdefinition" xmlns:rd="http://schemas.microsoft.com/SQLServer/reporting/reportdesigner">
  <AutoRefresh>0</AutoRefresh>

      <rd:SecurityType>None</rd:SecurityType>
    </DataSource>
  </DataSources>
  <DataSets>
$datasetsXml
  </DataSets>
  <ReportSections>
    <ReportSection>
      <Body>
        <ReportItems>
$bodyItems
        </ReportItems>
        <Height>$bodyHeight</Height>
        <Style><Border><Style>None</Style></Border></Style>

      <Width>7in</Width>

$paramsXml
$paramLayout

"@
}

# Student / Teacher picker parameter (dropdown from a list proc)
function PickerParam($pname, $listDs, $valField, $labelField, $prompt, $default){
@"
  <ReportParameters>
    <ReportParameter Name="$pname">
      <DataType>Integer</DataType>
      <Prompt>$prompt</Prompt>
      <ValidValues><DataSetReference><DataSetName>$listDs</DataSetName><ValueField>$valField</ValueField><LabelField>$labelField</LabelField></DataSetReference></ValidValues>
      <DefaultValue><Values><Value>$default</Value></Values></DefaultValue>
    </ReportParameter>
  </ReportParameters>
"@
}
$PLayout = "  <ReportParametersLayout><GridLayoutDefinition><NumberOfColumns>2</NumberOfColumns><NumberOfRows>1</NumberOfRows><CellDefinitions><CellDefinition><ColumnIndex>0</ColumnIndex><RowIndex>0</RowIndex><ParameterName>%%PNAME%%</ParameterName></CellDefinition></CellDefinitions></GridLayoutDefinition></ReportParametersLayout>"

$studentParamXml = "        <QueryParameters><QueryParameter Name=`"@Student_Id`"><Value>=Parameters!Student_Id.Value</Value></QueryParameter></QueryParameters>"
$teacherParamXml = "        <QueryParameters><QueryParameter Name=`"@Teacher_Id`"><Value>=Parameters!Teacher_Id.Value</Value></QueryParameter></QueryParameters>"

$studentListDs = ProcDataSet 'dsStudents' 'rpt_StudentList' '' (FieldsXml @(@{F='Student_Id';T='System.Int32'},@{F='Display_Name';T='System.String'}) $null)
$teacherListDs = ProcDataSet 'dsTeachers' 'rpt_TeacherList' '' (FieldsXml @(@{F='Teacher_Id';T='System.Int32'},@{F='Display_Name';T='System.String'}) $null)

# ============================================================================================
# 1) Student Schedule  (parameterized)
# ============================================================================================
$cols = @(
  @{F='Academic_Year';H='Year';   T='System.Int16'; W='0.6in'; A='Center'},
  @{F='Semester';     H='Sem';    T='System.Byte';  W='0.45in'; A='Center'},
  @{F='Subject_Name_En';H='Subject';T='System.String';W='1.5in';A='Left'},
  @{F='Subject_Name_Ar';H='Subject (AR)'; T='System.String';W='1.3in';A='Right'},
  @{F='Course_Level';  H='Level'; T='System.Byte';  W='0.55in'; A='Center'},
  @{F='Teacher_Name';  H='Teacher';T='System.String';W='1.45in';A='Left'},
  @{F='Class_Name';    H='Class'; T='System.String';W='0.7in'; A='Center'}
)
$ds = (ProcDataSet 'dsSchedule' 'rpt_StudentSchedule' $studentParamXml (FieldsXml $cols $null)) + "`n" + $studentListDs
$body = (TitleBox 'Student Schedule' '="Subjects and teachers for student #" & Parameters!Student_Id.Value') + (TableTablix 'tSched' 'dsSchedule' $cols '0.9in')
$rdl = ReportDoc $ds $body '2.2in' (PickerParam 'Student_Id' 'dsStudents' 'Student_Id' 'Display_Name' 'Student' '2026501') ($PLayout -replace '%%PNAME%%','Student_Id')
Set-Content -Path (Join-Path $here 'StudentSchedule.rdl') -Value $rdl -Encoding UTF8
Write-Host "wrote StudentSchedule.rdl"

# ============================================================================================
# 2) Teacher Schedule  (parameterized)  -> existing rpt_TeacherSchedule
# ============================================================================================
$cols = @(

  @{F='Semester';     H='Sem';  T='System.Byte';  W='0.7in'; A='Center'},
  @{F='Subject_Name_En';H='Subject';T='System.String';W='2.2in';A='Left'},
  @{F='Class_Level';  H='Class Level';T='System.Byte';W='1.1in';A='Center'},
  @{F='class_Letter'; H='Section';T='System.String';W='0.9in';A='Center'},

)
$ds = (ProcDataSet 'dsTSched' 'rpt_TeacherSchedule' $teacherParamXml (FieldsXml $cols $null)) + "`n" + $teacherListDs
$body = (TitleBox 'Teacher Schedule' '="Classes taught by teacher #" & Parameters!Teacher_Id.Value') + (TableTablix 'tTSched' 'dsTSched' $cols '0.9in')
$rdl = ReportDoc $ds $body '2.2in' (PickerParam 'Teacher_Id' 'dsTeachers' 'Teacher_Id' 'Display_Name' 'Teacher' '3007') ($PLayout -replace '%%PNAME%%','Teacher_Id')

# ============================================================================================

$cols = @(

$ds = ProcDataSet 'dsAddr' 'rpt_StudentAddress' $studentParamXml (FieldsXml $cols $null)

$rdl = ReportDoc $ds $body '2.2in' (PickerParam 'Student_Id' 'dsStudents' 'Student_Id' 'Display_Name' 'Student' '2026501') ($PLayout -replace '%%PNAME%%','Student_Id')

# ============================================================================================

$detFields = @(
  @{F='First_Name';T='System.String'},@{F='Last_Name';T='System.String'},@{F='Age';T='System.Int32'},
  @{F='Gender';T='System.String'},@{F='Blood_Type';T='System.String'},@{F='Medical_Conditions';T='System.String'},

  @{F='Parent_Phone';T='System.String'},@{F='Parent_Email';T='System.String'},@{F='Occupation';T='System.String'},

# A labelled field line: a label textbox + a value textbox bound via First(...,"dsDetails")
function InfoRow($label, $expr, $top){
@"
          <Textbox Name="lbl$([guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N').Substring(0,6))">
            <CanGrow>true</CanGrow><Paragraphs><Paragraph><TextRuns><TextRun><Value>$(XmlEsc $label)</Value>
              <Style><FontSize>9pt</FontSize><FontWeight>Bold</FontWeight><Color>#2e5b8a</Color></Style></TextRun></TextRuns></Paragraph></Paragraphs>
            <Top>$top</Top><Left>0in</Left><Height>0.22in</Height><Width>1.6in</Width><Style /></Textbox>
          <Textbox Name="val$([guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N').Substring(0,6))">
            <CanGrow>true</CanGrow><Paragraphs><Paragraph><TextRuns><TextRun><Value>$(XmlEsc $expr)</Value>
              <Style><FontSize>9pt</FontSize><Color>#222222</Color></Style></TextRun></TextRuns></Paragraph></Paragraphs>
            <Top>$top</Top><Left>1.7in</Left><Height>0.22in</Height><Width>4.6in</Width><Style /></Textbox>
"@
}

$info  = (TitleBox 'Student Details' '=First(Fields!First_Name.Value,"dsDetails") & " " & First(Fields!Last_Name.Value,"dsDetails")')
$info += (InfoRow 'Student ID'   '=First(Fields!Student_Id.Value,"dsDetails")' '0.8in')
$info += (InfoRow 'Class'        '=First(Fields!Class_Name.Value,"dsDetails")' '1.05in')
$info += (InfoRow 'Age / Gender' '=First(Fields!Age.Value,"dsDetails") & "  /  " & First(Fields!Gender.Value,"dsDetails")' '1.30in')
$info += (InfoRow 'Blood Type'   '=First(Fields!Blood_Type.Value,"dsDetails")' '1.55in')
$info += (InfoRow 'Medical'      '=IIF(IsNothing(First(Fields!Medical_Conditions.Value,"dsDetails")),"-",First(Fields!Medical_Conditions.Value,"dsDetails"))' '1.80in')
$info += (InfoRow 'Parent'       '=First(Fields!Parent_Name.Value,"dsDetails") & " (" & First(Fields!relationship.Value,"dsDetails") & ")"' '2.05in')
$info += (InfoRow 'Parent Phone' '=First(Fields!Parent_Phone.Value,"dsDetails")' '2.30in')
$info += (InfoRow 'Parent Email' '=First(Fields!Parent_Email.Value,"dsDetails")' '2.55in')
$info += (InfoRow 'Occupation'   '=First(Fields!Occupation.Value,"dsDetails")' '2.80in')
$info += (InfoRow 'GPA'          '=First(Fields!GPA.Value,"dsDetails")' '3.05in')
$info += (InfoRow 'Class Rank'   '=First(Fields!Class_Rank.Value,"dsDetails")' '3.30in')

# Drill-through link to the Student Address report (same folder, relative name)
$drill = @"
          <Textbox Name="DrillAddress">
            <CanGrow>true</CanGrow><Paragraphs><Paragraph><TextRuns><TextRun><Value>View address report »</Value>
              <Style><FontSize>10pt</FontSize><FontWeight>Bold</FontWeight><Color>#1a73e8</Color><TextDecoration>Underline</TextDecoration></Style>
              <ActionInfo><Actions><Action><Drillthrough><ReportName>StudentAddress</ReportName>
                <Parameters><Parameter Name="Student_Id"><Value>=Parameters!Student_Id.Value</Value></Parameter></Parameters>
              </Drillthrough></Action></Actions></ActionInfo></TextRun></TextRuns></Paragraph></Paragraphs>
            <Top>3.7in</Top><Left>0in</Left><Height>0.25in</Height><Width>3in</Width><Style /></Textbox>
"@

# Section label for the subreport
$subLabel = @"

            <Top>4.15in</Top><Left>0in</Left><Height>0.3in</Height><Width>4in</Width><Style /></Textbox>
"@

# Subreport: embed Student Marks, passing the same Student_Id
$sub = @"

            <ReportName>StudentMarks</ReportName>

            <Top>4.5in</Top><Left>0in</Left><Height>1.6in</Height><Width>6.5in</Width>
            <Style><Border><Style>None</Style></Border></Style>
          </Subreport>
"@

$body = $info + $drill + $subLabel + $sub
$rdl = ReportDoc $dsDet $body '6.2in' (PickerParam 'Student_Id' 'dsStudents' 'Student_Id' 'Display_Name' 'Student' '2026501') ($PLayout -replace '%%PNAME%%','Student_Id')
Set-Content -Path (Join-Path $here 'StudentDetails.rdl') -Value $rdl -Encoding UTF8
Write-Host "wrote StudentDetails.rdl"

# 6) Students by Class  (DRILL-DOWN: each class header toggles its students open/closed)

$cbCols = @(

@"

"@
}
$cbGroupRow = @"

                      </Textbox>
                    </CellContents></TablixCell>
$(BandCell)$(BandCell)$(BandCell)
"@

$cbTablix = @"

$cbColDefs              </TablixColumns>

                <TablixRow><Height>0.3in</Height><TablixCells>

                <TablixRow><Height>0.25in</Height><TablixCells>
$cbDetail                </TablixCells></TablixRow>
              </TablixRows>
            </TablixBody>
            <TablixColumnHierarchy><TablixMembers>
                  <TablixMember /><TablixMember /><TablixMember /><TablixMember />
            </TablixMembers></TablixColumnHierarchy>
            <TablixRowHierarchy><TablixMembers>
                <TablixMember><KeepWithGroup>After</KeepWithGroup></TablixMember>
                <TablixMember>
                  <Group Name="ClassGroup"><GroupExpressions><GroupExpression>=Fields!Class_Name.Value</GroupExpression></GroupExpressions></Group>
                  <SortExpressions><SortExpression><Value>=Fields!Class_Level.Value</Value></SortExpression><SortExpression><Value>=Fields!class_Letter.Value</Value></SortExpression></SortExpressions>

                      <SortExpressions><SortExpression><Value>=Fields!Student_Name.Value</Value></SortExpression></SortExpressions>
                      <Visibility><Hidden>true</Hidden><ToggleItem>ClassHeader</ToggleItem></Visibility>
                      <TablixMembers><TablixMember /></TablixMembers>
                    </TablixMember>
                  </TablixMembers>
                </TablixMember>
            </TablixMembers></TablixRowHierarchy>
            <DataSetName>dsByClass</DataSetName>
            <Top>0.9in</Top><Left>0in</Left><Height>0.83in</Height><Width>5.4in</Width>
          </Tablix>

$body = (TitleBox 'Students by Class' 'Click a class to expand or collapse its students') + $cbTablix

Set-Content -Path (Join-Path $here 'StudentsByClass.rdl') -Value $rdl -Encoding UTF8
Write-Host "wrote StudentsByClass.rdl"

# ============================================================================================
# Optional publish to SSRS
# ============================================================================================
if($Deploy){
    $proxy = New-WebServiceProxy -Uri "$ReportServer/ReportService2010.asmx" -UseDefaultCredential
    $ns = $proxy.GetType().Namespace
    # ensure folder
    try { $proxy.CreateFolder((Split-Path $PortalFolder -Leaf), '/', $null) } catch {}
    foreach($f in 'StudentSchedule','TeacherSchedule','StudentMarks','StudentAddress','StudentDetails','StudentsByClass'){
        $bytes = [IO.File]::ReadAllBytes((Join-Path $here "$f.rdl"))

        $proxy.CreateCatalogItem('Report', $f, $PortalFolder, $true, $bytes, $null, [ref]$warnings) | Out-Null
        if($warnings){ foreach($w in $warnings){ Write-Host "  [warn] $f : $($w.Message)" } }
        Write-Host "published $f"
    }
    Write-Host "Done. Open $ReportServer -> $PortalFolder"
}

USE MYSchoolDB;
GO
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.tables WHERE name = 'Data_Audit')
BEGIN
    CREATE TABLE Data_Audit (
        Audit_Id       INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,
        Audit_DateTime DATETIME2     NOT NULL DEFAULT SYSDATETIME(),
        Table_Name     NVARCHAR(50)  NOT NULL,
        Action_Type    VARCHAR(10)   NOT NULL,   -- INSERT / UPDATE / DELETE
        Record_Key     NVARCHAR(200) NULL,
        Column_Name    NVARCHAR(50)  NULL,
        Old_Value      NVARCHAR(200) NULL,
        New_Value      NVARCHAR(200) NULL,
        Changed_By     NVARCHAR(128) NOT NULL DEFAULT SUSER_SNAME()
    );
END

GO

-- 1) Capacity check : a class may never exceed its Student_Capacity
IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.objects WHERE type='TR' AND name='trg_Student_CapacityChecker')
    DROP TRIGGER trg_Student_CapacityChecker;
GO
CREATE TRIGGER trg_Student_CapacityChecker
ON Student
AFTER INSERT, UPDATE
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    IF EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM class c
        JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT Class_Level, class_Letter FROM inserted) i
          ON i.Class_Level = c.Class_Level AND i.class_Letter = c.class_Letter
        WHERE (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Student s
                WHERE s.Class_Level = c.Class_Level AND s.class_Letter = c.class_Letter) > c.Student_Capacity
    )
    BEGIN
        ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
        THROW 50001, 'Class capacity exceeded: this would put the class over its Student_Capacity.', 1;
    END
END
GO

-- 2) Level match: a grade's Course_Level must equal the student's Class_Level
IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.objects WHERE type='TR' AND name='trg_StudentGrades_LevelMatch')
    DROP TRIGGER trg_StudentGrades_LevelMatch;
GO
CREATE TRIGGER trg_StudentGrades_LevelMatch
ON Student_Grades
AFTER INSERT, UPDATE
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    IF EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM inserted i
        JOIN Student s ON s.Student_Id = i.Student_Id
        WHERE i.Course_Level <> s.Class_Level
        -- To allow multi-year history later, add:  AND i.Academic_Year = YEAR(GETDATE())
    )
    BEGIN
        ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
        THROW 50002, 'Level mismatch: a grade''s Course_Level must equal the student''s Class_Level.', 1;
    END
END
GO

-- 3) Required-level Checker: a course can't be assigned below its subject's Required_Level
IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.objects WHERE type='TR' AND name='trg_Assignment_RequiredLevel')
    DROP TRIGGER trg_Assignment_RequiredLevel;
GO
CREATE TRIGGER trg_Assignment_RequiredLevel
ON Teacher_Class_Assignments
AFTER INSERT, UPDATE
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    IF EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM inserted i
        JOIN Subjects s ON s.Subject_Id = i.Subject_Id
        WHERE i.Course_Level < s.Required_Level
    )
    BEGIN
        ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
        THROW 50003, 'Required-level violation: course level is below the subject''s minimum Required_Level.', 1;
    END
END

GO
IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.objects WHERE type='TR' AND name='trg_StudentGrades_Audit')
    DROP TRIGGER trg_StudentGrades_Audit;
GO
CREATE TRIGGER trg_StudentGrades_Audit
ON Student_Grades
AFTER UPDATE, DELETE
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    -- UPDATE: one audit row per changed grade column
    IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inserted)
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO Data_Audit (Table_Name, Action_Type, Record_Key, Column_Name, Old_Value, New_Value)
        SELECT 'Student_Grades', 'UPDATE',
               CONCAT(d.Academic_Year,'/',d.Semester,'/S',d.Student_Id,'/',d.Subject_Id,'-L',d.Course_Level),
               col.Column_Name, col.Old_Value, col.New_Value
        FROM deleted d
        JOIN inserted i
          ON i.Academic_Year=d.Academic_Year AND i.Semester=d.Semester
         AND i.Student_Id=d.Student_Id AND i.Subject_Id=d.Subject_Id AND i.Course_Level=d.Course_Level
        CROSS APPLY (VALUES
            ('First_Grade',  CAST(d.First_Grade  AS NVARCHAR(200)), CAST(i.First_Grade  AS NVARCHAR(200))),
            ('Second_Grade', CAST(d.Second_Grade AS NVARCHAR(200)), CAST(i.Second_Grade AS NVARCHAR(200))),
            ('third_Grade',  CAST(d.third_Grade  AS NVARCHAR(200)), CAST(i.third_Grade  AS NVARCHAR(200))),
            ('Final_Grade',  CAST(d.Final_Grade  AS NVARCHAR(200)), CAST(i.Final_Grade  AS NVARCHAR(200)))
        ) AS col(Column_Name, Old_Value, New_Value)
        WHERE ISNULL(col.Old_Value,'') <> ISNULL(col.New_Value,'');
    END
    ELSE  -- DELETE: snapshot of the removed row
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO Data_Audit (Table_Name, Action_Type, Record_Key, Column_Name, Old_Value, New_Value)
        SELECT 'Student_Grades', 'DELETE',
               CONCAT(d.Academic_Year,'/',d.Semester,'/S',d.Student_Id,'/',d.Subject_Id,'-L',d.Course_Level),
               'AllGrades',
               CONCAT('1st=',d.First_Grade,' 2nd=',d.Second_Grade,' 3rd=',d.third_Grade,' Final=',d.Final_Grade),
               NULL
        FROM deleted d;
    END
END

USE MySchoolDB
GO

-- 1. All grade detail per student/subject
IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.objects WHERE type='V' AND name='Student_All_Details')
    DROP VIEW Student_All_Details;
GO
CREATE VIEW Student_All_Details AS
SELECT Student.Student_id, Student.First_Name AS SFN, Student.Last_Name AS SLN,
       Student.Class_Level, Student.class_Letter,
       Teacher.First_name, Teacher.Last_name,
       Subjects.Subject_Name_Ar, Subjects.Subject_Name_En,
       Student_Grades.First_Grade, Student_Grades.Second_Grade,
       Student_Grades.third_Grade, Student_Grades.Final_Grade,
       (SELECT CAST(AVG(CAST(m.Mark AS DECIMAL(5,2))) AS DECIMAL(5,2))
          FROM (VALUES (Student_Grades.First_Grade), (Student_Grades.Second_Grade),
                       (Student_Grades.third_Grade), (Student_Grades.Final_Grade)) AS m(Mark))
          AS Student_Avg_Grade   -- marks entered so far, with decimals
FROM Student_Grades
INNER JOIN Student ON Student.Student_Id = Student_Grades.Student_Id
INNER JOIN Teacher_Class_Assignments
    ON Teacher_Class_Assignments.Class_Level  = Student.Class_Level
   AND Teacher_Class_Assignments.class_Letter = Student.class_Letter
   AND Teacher_Class_Assignments.Subject_Id   = Student_Grades.Subject_Id
   AND Teacher_Class_Assignments.Course_Level = Student_Grades.Course_Level
INNER JOIN Teacher  ON Teacher.Teacher_Id  = Teacher_Class_Assignments.Teacher_Id
INNER JOIN Subjects ON Subjects.Subject_Id = Student_Grades.Subject_Id;
GO

-- 2. Teachers per subject
IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.objects WHERE type='V' AND name='Number_of_Teachers_each_Subject')
    DROP VIEW Number_of_Teachers_each_Subject;
GO
CREATE VIEW Number_of_Teachers_each_Subject AS
SELECT Subjects.Subject_Name_Ar, Subjects.Subject_Name_En,
       COUNT(DISTINCT Teacher_Class_Assignments.Teacher_Id) AS Number_of_Teachers
FROM Teacher_Class_Assignments
INNER JOIN Subjects ON Subjects.Subject_Id = Teacher_Class_Assignments.Subject_Id
GROUP BY Subjects.Subject_Name_Ar, Subjects.Subject_Name_En;
GO

-- 3. Students per governorate
IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.objects WHERE type='V' AND name='Student_Numbers_each_governate')
    DROP VIEW Student_Numbers_each_governate;
GO
CREATE VIEW Student_Numbers_each_governate AS
SELECT Governorates.Gov_Name_Ar, Governorates.Gov_Name_En,
       COUNT(DISTINCT Student_Addresses.Student_Id) AS Number_of_Students
FROM Student_Addresses
INNER JOIN Address      ON Student_Addresses.Address_Id = Address.Address_Id
INNER JOIN Governorates ON Governorates.Gov_Id = Address.Gov_Id
GROUP BY Governorates.Gov_Name_Ar, Governorates.Gov_Name_En;
GO

-- 4. Student overall average (0–100)
IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.objects WHERE type='V' AND name='Student_General_Grade')
    DROP VIEW Student_General_Grade;
GO
CREATE VIEW Student_General_Grade AS
-- Same rule as calculate_Student_Overall_Grade: average of the marks entered, with decimals
SELECT Student_Id,
       AVG(CAST(m.Mark AS FLOAT)) AS student_Avg_Grade
FROM Student_Grades
CROSS APPLY (VALUES (First_Grade), (Second_Grade), (third_Grade), (Final_Grade)) AS m(Mark)
GROUP BY Student_Id;
GO

-- 5. Top three students per class
IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.objects WHERE type='V' AND name='Student_First_Three_for_each_class')
    DROP VIEW Student_First_Three_for_each_class;
GO
CREATE VIEW Student_First_Three_for_each_class AS
WITH Ranked AS (
    SELECT Student.Student_id, Student.First_Name, Student.Last_Name,
           Student.Class_Level, Student.class_Letter, Student_General_Grade.student_Avg_Grade,
           DENSE_RANK() OVER (
               PARTITION BY Student.Class_Level, Student.class_Letter
               ORDER BY Student_General_Grade.student_Avg_Grade DESC
           ) AS Student_rank
    FROM Student_General_Grade
    INNER JOIN Student ON Student.Student_Id = Student_General_Grade.Student_Id
)
SELECT Student_id, First_Name, Last_Name, Class_Level, class_Letter, student_Avg_Grade, Student_rank
FROM Ranked
WHERE Student_rank <= 3;          -- top three (was <= 2)
GO
